_comment: Seed cosmetic catalogue for the Cosmetic Shop + Glimmer system. Ported from docs/cosmetic-shop-spec.md in the React repo. Twelve launch items: 4 hero skins (one per class plus a free-path mage variant), 4 pet skins (aether / flame / ice plus a free-path ice variant), 4 village skins (heart lantern + 3 building palettes). Glimmer is a soft currency: earned in-game (wave milestones, daily quests, login streaks) or buyable in bundles. unlockMethod 'buy' = ordinary Glimmer purchase; 'achievement' = free-path item that is granted by gameplay milestones (Equip works once owned; TryPurchase will refuse). previewColor is the hex used as a swatch in the shop card before the proper preview portraits land.

items.description: Robes spun from autumn leaves and Heartwood ash.
Plate rimed with the breath of the high passes.
Greens of the first thaw stitched into oilskin.
Earned by playing five days in season. Beauty is earned, never required.
A crystal-fairy aether sprite wreathed in slow drifting violet glow. Special-sale launch cosmetic.
Coat the colour of a banked forge, sparks at the heel.
Fur of pale frost; the snow remembers its tread.
Reach Bond rank 3 with the Ice Wolf to unlock.
The Heart's lantern glows pale blue through a rime of frost.
Granite blocks fitted by old craft, moss in every seam.
Pet House, Workshop, Arcane Tower and Farm in autumn warmth.
Granted on the first ten-wave clear of the spring season.
